punchline: West pitched Eagle as insurance, not as a rival.
thirty_sec: In 1978 Data General sent Fountainhead to North Carolina to answer the VAX; Tom West stayed in Massachusetts and pitched Edson de Castro a 32-bit Eclipse within a year as insurance, and it took longer.
question: Which idea of yours would get a yes faster as a small backup beside something already approved?
key_contrast: A narrow compatible target instead of a grand rival design.
